integrity: The reconstruction lemma gives an all-cardinality proof. The included independent-of-proof finite enumerator checks all three-level isometry types through eight points, but is not used as a proof of the infinite-size claim. No external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional distance-aware colour refinement distinguishes spaces only relative to the fixed-alphabet ultrametric class, not among arbitrary relational structures. Upper bound h-1 is not claimed optimal for h>3. The exact eight-point classification is in a fixed labelled alphabet allowing unused levels. Earlier unindexed publications may contain equivalent facts.
title: Distance-aware colour refinement on finite ultrametrics: two rounds suffice and eight points first defeat one
